# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For every implementation PR, complete all changes and tests, then perform one explicit adversarial self-review/self-challenge immediately before committing; fix any findings and rerun validation before creating commits.
- Continue autonomously through the active PR milestone, including implementation, validation, self-review, commit, push, and PR creation. Pause only for a genuine blocker, a material design/preference decision needing user input, or the manual PR review/merge gate.

## Development Considerations
- PitchBot development must include graceful human-like handling of abuse, aggression, insults, repeated statements, excessive goal changes, internal-information extraction, jailbreaks, and prompt injection.
- Evaluations should cover diverse buyer personalities, languages, business categories, short fake-time callbacks, audio quality, sample decks, and safely cited competitor inspiration.
